scope.focus: SOMA personal online adaptation lineage: candidate training, feedback weighting, safety gates, snapshots/rollback, resource lifecycle and failure modes relevant to FRANK v0.1 adaptive visual learning

lineage.event: Introduced SOMA as an out-of-band personal-adaptation subsystem: conversation scoring, bounded idle training, pre-deploy drift/similarity/NaN gates, snapshots, EMA blending, GGUF conversion/hot reload and rollback. The commit reports 50 real chat iterations, 104 conversations scored, 80 qualified and one 18.7-minute CPU training/deploy cycle; these are preserved as historical commit-reported measurements, not independently reverified runtime facts.

Added explicit thumbs-up/down provenance paired to prompting user text and made explicit feedback a high-weight training-quality signal; widened LoRA attention targets. This is evidence for provenance-aware preference signals, not evidence that explicit feedback is epistemic truth.

Deep audit exposed authoritative online-learning failures: wrong/dead score columns, leaked DB connection, corrupted timestamp handling, EMA blend dropping new keys, model-memory leak on error, background worker not stopping, false-safe zero-baseline drift and TOCTOU artifact checks.

Later rebuild added persisted cycle state, feedback-window reset, stronger weighted-positive/negative training semantics, explicit service stop ordering/masking to prevent restart conflicts and lighter bfloat16 training while keeping LoRA parameters in float32.

reusable_mechanism.name: transactional_candidate_adaptation_envelope
reusable_mechanism.description: The historically reusable mechanism is not SOMA LoRA itself but the surrounding transactional adaptation pattern: provenance-scoped examples -> bounded candidate update -> shadow validation -> last-known-good snapshot -> atomic promotion -> versioned rollback/recovery -> persistent cycle cursor and resource/worker cleanup.
transfer_to_mvc: Keep feature/example receipts versioned by user/workspace, source, evidence tier and feature-backbone identity.
Treat GOLD/SILVER labels as admissible training evidence and BRONZE/self-generated labels as non-authoritative unless independently promoted under the current visual-learning contract.
Train/update candidate prototype/readout state off the authoritative active path.
Evaluate candidate against frozen replay, recent held-out user examples, retention/forgetting cases, open-set negatives, calibration and resource budgets before promotion.
Snapshot and retain last-known-good classifier/prototype state before every authoritative promotion.
Promote atomically and persist candidate/current version identity, thresholds, feature-backbone compatibility and rollback metadata.
Make disable/stop semantics real: no ghost learner thread, restart loop or hidden continuing update after the learner is disabled.
Persist cycle cursors/feedback windows so evidence is not replayed or double-counted across restarts.
Clean large model/feature/training objects on success and every error path; perception must remain available when adaptation pauses or fails.

negative_results.result: EMA blending iterated only old adapter keys and silently dropped new keys.
negative_results.impact: Candidate/current state compatibility cannot be inferred from partial key overlap; adaptive visual state migration must validate the complete feature/class/prototype/readout contract before blend or promotion.

negative_results.result: Near-zero old adapter norm produced relative drift 0.0 and therefore a false-safe drift result.
negative_results.impact: Fresh/empty visual baselines need an explicit absolute-distance or alternate calibration path; zero denominator must never mean zero risk.

negative_results.result: Disabling Personal Mode did not reliably stop the background worker and stop() did not join it.
negative_results.impact: Adaptive visual learning requires observable worker lifecycle and hard stop semantics so disabled/over-budget learning cannot continue invisibly.

negative_results.result: Training-model objects were not freed on all error paths.
negative_results.impact: Background adaptation can degrade or destabilize foreground perception through resource leakage unless cleanup is a tested invariant.

negative_results.result: Scored-interaction persistence wrote obsolete dimensions instead of the actual current scorer outputs.
negative_results.impact: Schema names and semantic field identities need typed/versioned migration and replay tests; healthy writes are not equivalent to semantically correct learner data.

negative_results.result: Explicit user feedback was intentionally made a dominant training signal.
negative_results.impact: For the visual learner, user confirmation/preference can be a strong provenance signal but must remain distinct from sensor truth, class identity evidence and open-set calibration to prevent preference-driven Goodhart or poisoning.

current_inheritance.delta: Adopt a transactional candidate/promotion/rollback envelope around MVC-0/MVC-1 state. Carry example tier/provenance, classifier/prototype version, feature-backbone version, calibration identity, held-out evaluation and atomic last-known-good rollback as first-class state.

Learning must fail closed to the familiar fast path: adaptation failure, incompatibility, ambiguous/open-set score or stale classifier state escalates to deeper perception and never suppresses sensor evidence.

Regressionize PF-SOMA-FAIL-001..005 plus feedback-poisoning/Goodhart: complete-state migration, zero-baseline drift, real worker stop, failed-update resource cleanup, semantic schema correctness and no untrusted-feedback promotion.

Persist candidate/current/LKG version graph, example provenance/tier, feature-backbone compatibility, calibration thresholds, update-cycle cursor, rejection reason, rollback ancestry and resource/evaluation receipts without equating familiarity with evidence.

Learner transitions should be replayable typed contracts: collect/admit -> update_candidate -> evaluate -> reject|promote -> rollback, with explicit version identities, evidence tiers, budget state and effect receipts.
MVC familiarity may alter routing/attention cost but never becomes workspace truth authority. User preference, confidence and learned familiarity remain separate from sensor/evidence provenance.

cheap_discriminating_tests: Create an empty/fresh classifier baseline and assert drift/risk evaluation cannot return safe merely because the baseline norm/support is zero.
Add/remove one feature/class dimension between candidate and current state and require explicit compatibility migration or hard rejection; no silent partial blend.
Disable or force over-budget learning during an active update and assert the worker exits, no restart loop resurrects it, perception remains active and no candidate is promoted.
Inject a failure after feature/model allocation and assert CPU/RAM/thread counts return within frozen tolerance without losing current classifier state.
Replay a schema-version mismatch where field names exist but semantics changed and require migration/replay failure rather than successful but wrong persistence.
Provide strongly positive user feedback for a deliberately mislabeled/unknown visual sample and assert it cannot become GOLD/SILVER training truth without independent evidence admission.
Crash between candidate validation and promotion and assert restart deterministically restores either previous current or fully committed new current, never a mixed state.

crossread.adaptive_visual_directive: Current fixed FRANK v0.1 directive independently requires GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE admission, bounded cyclic candidate update, replay/retention/open-set evaluation, atomic promotion and last-known-good rollback.
crossread.subconscious_lineage_overlap: Existing PF Subconscious receipt already captures adjacent online-learning lessons such as schema migration, silent transition-write failure, dimension growth and rollback/health shadows. This SOMA receipt adds distinct candidate-artifact, drift-baseline, worker-lifecycle, resource-cleanup and explicit-feedback lineage; overlap is flagged for earned-work dedup.

earned_work.reason: Strong reusable architecture and negative-result value, but historical SOMA mechanisms overlap existing adaptive-learning/Subconscious/LCME/Retina mappings. Row-level dedup is required before any avoided-work credit.

level0_effect.reason: This is a semantic/history lineage shard. Project-Frankenstein repository-wide tree/history denominator remains unfrozen, so the current exact Level-0 completion law forbids positive global percentage credit.
